These notes write the [observed information](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-oinf) as $\oinf$ and the [expected information](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-einf) as $\einf$.
Sources disagree on these symbols.
The [Notation Across Sources page](https://morrison-lab.github.io/macros/notation-across-sources.html#sec-notation-information) of the macros site lists them side by side.
